title: session_started
description: Emitted by the plugin when it initialises and connects to the server

chat_capture_mode.description: How the plugin gates chat capture. 'Receive' (normal) emits only on message receipt, so the chat backlog is never replayed. 'SuppressHistory' is a weaker fallback that skips the known redraw path. 'Legacy' means neither gate could be installed and the backlog WILL be re-emitted once per race — a server must then dedupe on (session_id, chat_id). 'None' means chat capture is not installed at all.
